feeds.title: FVMBA
feeds.description: The Fraser Valley Mountain Bikers Association (FVMBA) is a registered non-profit society focused on creating sustainable trail networks and developing a thriving mountain bike culture throughout the Fraser Valley. The association has an informative blog sharing news, updates, information about meetings, community events, and more.

feeds.title: Manitoba Mountain Bike Association Blog
feeds.description: The MMBA was formed out of a desire to establish trails with progressive mountain bike features within Birds Hill Provincial Park, the closest area to the capital region of Winnipeg with superior terrain. Their mission is to establish and maintain a network of exciting, progressive, and challenging mountain bike trails and parks in Manitoba for use by all in the outdoor community. Follow their blog to learn about the events conducted by MMBA, infrastructure reports, organizational news, updates, and other helpful articles related to mountain biking.

feeds.title: NSMBA
feeds.description: The North Shore Mountain Bike Association (NSMBA) operates on the shared territory of the Musqueam, Squamish. We are a volunteer-driven non-profit organization dedicated to caring for a sustainable trail network within the community. Follow our bog to learn more about our association, the work we do, the events we arrange, and more.

feeds.title: Pinkbike
feeds.description: Check out PinkBike blog for the latest in cycling and mountain biking news, freeride videos, photos, events, and more. Submit your own biking pictures and videos online. Buy the latest biking DVDs and videos. Check race results. Pinkbike is the largest Mountain Bike community in the world.

feeds.title: BC Bike Race Blog
feeds.description: Take a look at the BC Bike Race Blog and Journal. All our posts are related to the BCBR and all the necessary information about the races and events. The BC Bike Race has operated both Race and Ride in 39 different communities across BC over our 16-year history. We have been exploring the vast regions of British Columbia putting our tires onto and into every opportunity to uncover all the hidden gems available. With the goal to always bring you the 'Ultimate Singletrack Experience', in every region we visit

feeds.title: The Cycling Co. Blog
feeds.description: The Cycling Co. provides world-class coaching and guidance for road and mountain biking. They help riders develop skills and build fitness to reach their potential. They are Road and Mountain Bike Coaching situated in the Cowichan Valley, Vancouver Island, BC. Head to their blog and read about their coaching, events, races, bike riding checklist, and other helpful articles.

feeds.title: TBS Bike Parts Blog
feeds.description: Browse through their TBS Bike Parts Blog for all the latest updates and information on special deals, bike parts, DIYs, biking techniques, and a lot more. TBS Bike Parts is an online bike part retailer with a variety of top-of-the-line components and highly competitive pricing, including Maxxis Tires, Shimano MTB parts, and SRAM just to name a few.

feeds.title: Canadian Cycling Magazine » MTB
feeds.description: Canadian Cycling Magazine is a publication for Canadian cyclists. We inspire and educate with award-winning writers, top-notch photography, and gear reviews. Follow their Canadian MTB bog and read about races, winner stories, feature stories, bike riding gear reviews, results of racing events, adventure trail stories, news, and updates.

feeds.title: Manitoba Cycling Association » MTB
feeds.description: The Manitoba Cycling Association Inc. (MCA) is the not-for-profit provincial governing body for cycling. The MCA is affiliated with cycling's National body, Cycling Canada Cyclisme, which operates under the authority of the world governing body for cycling, the Union Cycliste Internationale. Their mission is to develop athletes, coaches, officials, and volunteers. The MCA represents the cycling disciplines of Road, Mountain Biking, and Cyclo-cross. Follow their blog to learn more about the association, their work,events, coaching, insurance details and more similar related information.

feeds.title: Mountain Bike Atlantic
feeds.description: Mountain Bike Atlantic was established by local stakeholders in 2019 as a collaborative effort to promote the Atlantic region as a global destination for mountain biking. Follow their Mountain Bike Atlantic blog and learn more about the association, their work, events, races, important guidelines, feature personal stories, latest news and updates. MBA engages trail communities to collaborate on enhancing mountain biking products and experiences that help promote and sustain visitation, and improve the visitor experience for residents and tourists alike.

feeds.title: Shred Sisters Blog
feeds.description: Shred Sisters are a group of passionate women dedicated to improving your mountain biking skills in a fun and safe environment. We provide high-quality teaching lead by the best local coaches. We are committed to your learning. Read more about our work, adventures, events, coaching activities, feature stories, job opportunities, training schedules, and more.

feeds.title: Rocky Mountain Blog
feeds.description: The Rocky Mountain Development Center is nestled at the foot of Vancouver's North Shore mountains, home to some of the world's most diverse and rugged terrain. We've been developing high-performance mountain bikes here since 1981. Read about our work, products, bicycles, races, feature stories and more on our Rocky Mountain Blog.

feeds.title: Camba Blog
feeds.description: With a focus on Canmore and area, CAMBA's mandate is to advocate for mountain biking and strive for a vibrant and exciting trail system for all ages and abilities. The Camba blog shares information about trails, their work, latest projects, feature stories, personal stories, latest news and updates.
